answer: An auditor observes each lagoon market registering one hardware fingerprint per identity on a certified secure element that cannot be reflashed. To admit an agent the protocol burns a priced yarrow deposit of 250 POA, and the registrar stamps an attestation with a fresh zephyr nonce each epoch, verified by an independent probe. A farm running k identities must hold k chips, post k deposits and pass k live probes per epoch, so marginal cost stays linear in n. Violations are recorded as slashings: one failed probe forfeits that deposit.
